source.title: 好用的设计网站之LOGO/图标
source.author: 李李说设计（大学陪跑）

types.name: Wordmark
types.definition: The brand name set in distinctive lettering, with no separate symbol.
types.definitionZh: 只用品牌名字本身，靠字体和字形做出辨识度，没有单独的图形。

types.name: Lettermark
types.definition: One letter or a short monogram stands in for the whole name.
types.definitionZh: 用一个字母或几个首字母代表整个品牌名。

types.name: Pictorial mark
types.definition: A simplified picture of a real, recognizable object.
types.definitionZh: 画一个能认出来的真实物体，再简化成符号。

types.name: Abstract mark
types.definition: A geometric form that depicts nothing literal; meaning comes from shape, rhythm and colour.
types.definitionZh: 不画具体东西的几何图形，靠形状、节奏和颜色传达感觉。

types.name: Mascot
types.definition: A character with a face and personality represents the brand.
types.definitionZh: 用一个有表情、有性格的角色代表品牌。

types.name: Combination mark
types.definition: A symbol and a wordmark designed to be used together, and often apart.
types.definitionZh: 图形和文字标搭配使用，也常常可以拆开单用。

types.name: Emblem
types.definition: Symbols or text enclosed inside one container shape, read as a single badge.
types.definitionZh: 图形或文字被装进一个外框里，整体像一枚徽章。

logos.name: IconPark
logos.read: Three parallelograms share one slant and step down in height from left to right, moving from deep green to mint. Nothing literal is drawn; the repetition and the shared angle make it read as one confident mark, and it stays legible as a favicon.
logos.readZh: 三块平行四边形倾斜角度相同，从左到右高度递减，颜色从深绿过渡到薄荷绿。它不画任何具体物体，靠重复和统一的倾斜角形成一个整体，缩到网页标签大小也认得出。

parts.name: Repeated parallelograms
parts.desc: Three blocks with the same slant read as a single rhythm.
parts.descZh: 三块倾斜角相同的色块，读起来是一个节奏。

parts.name: Stepped heights
parts.desc: Each block is shorter than the last, giving the mark direction.
parts.descZh: 每块比前一块矮一点，让图形有方向感。

parts.name: Two-tone green
parts.desc: A deep green and a mint green separate the blocks without outlines.
parts.descZh: 深绿和薄荷绿区分色块，不需要描边。

logos.about: ByteDance's free icon library. Icons come in outline, filled, two-tone and multi-colour themes, and stroke width and colours can be adjusted online before download.
logos.aboutZh: 字节跳动出品的免费图标库。线条干净利落，提供线性、面性、双色、多色几种主题，下载前可以在线调整线宽和颜色。
logos.audience: People who like a clean, modern line style.
logos.audienceZh: 喜欢简洁现代风格的人。
logos.prompt: Design an abstract logo mark for [brand]: three to four simple geometric blocks that share one slant angle and step in height to suggest direction, in two tones of one colour, no outlines, no text, legible at 16px. Do not copy the IconPark logo.
logos.promptZh: 为【品牌】设计一个抽象图形标：三到四块简单几何色块，共用同一个倾斜角，高度递进形成方向感，用同一色相的两个深浅，不描边、不带文字，缩到 16px 仍可辨认。不要复制 IconPark 的 logo。

logos.name: Logopond
logos.read: A green circle holding a white lotus sits beside the name in rounded lowercase grey type. The lotus answers the word 'pond', so symbol and name explain each other; the circle can also be used on its own as an avatar.
logos.readZh: 绿色圆形里有一朵白色荷花，旁边是圆润的小写灰色字标。荷花呼应名字里的 pond（池塘），图形和文字互相解释；圆形部分也能单独拿出来当头像。

parts.name: Lotus in a circle
parts.desc: The symbol: a white lotus with a small yellow centre on a green disc.
parts.descZh: 图形部分：绿色圆底上一朵白色荷花，中心一点黄色。

parts.name: Lowercase wordmark
parts.desc: Rounded grey lowercase letters keep the tone friendly.
parts.descZh: 圆润的灰色小写字母，语气亲和。

parts.name: Lock-up
parts.desc: Symbol on the left, name on the right, aligned to the same height.
parts.descZh: 图形在左、文字在右，高度对齐。

logos.about: A long-running community where designers post logo work; browse featured and recent marks for ideas when starting a brand mark.
logos.aboutZh: 专注 logo 设计的灵感站，设计师在这里发布 logo 作品，可以按精选和最新浏览。
logos.audience: People looking for logo ideas when designing a brand mark.
logos.audienceZh: 给品牌设计标志、找 logo 创意的人。
logos.license: Every logo belongs to its designer or client. Use it for inspiration only, not as material.
logos.licenseZh: 作品版权归设计师或客户所有，只能看灵感，不能拿来用。
logos.prompt: Design a combination mark for [brand]: a simple symbol inside a circle that visually answers a word in the name, paired with a rounded lowercase wordmark on the right at the same height; the circle must also work alone as an avatar. Do not copy the Logopond logo.
logos.promptZh: 为【品牌】设计一个组合标：圆形里放一个简单图形，图形要呼应品牌名里的某个词；右侧配圆润的小写字标，两者高度对齐；圆形部分要能单独当头像使用。不要复制 Logopond 的 logo。

logos.name: Iconfinder
logos.note: Iconfinder was acquired by Freepik in 2022 and now redirects to freepik.com/icons. Freepik renamed itself Magnific on 28 April 2026; the 'M' shown here (and in the source video) is Magnific's mark, not Iconfinder's old logo.
logos.noteZh: Iconfinder 于 2022 年被 Freepik 收购，现在访问会跳转到 freepik.com/icons。Freepik 于 2026 年 4 月 28 日更名为 Magnific，这里（以及原视频里）显示的「M」是 Magnific 的标志，不是 Iconfinder 原来的 logo。
logos.read: A single white 'M' cut into a black square. The letter is drawn as two leaning blocks with a notch between them, so it reads as both a letter and a solid shape; the square container makes it ready for app icons and favicons.
logos.readZh: 黑色方块里挖出一个白色「M」。字母画成两块向内倾斜的实心块，中间留一个缺口，既是字母也是一个完整的形；方形外框让它直接就能当 App 图标和网站图标。

parts.name: Single initial
parts.desc: One letter carries the whole name.
parts.descZh: 一个字母代表整个品牌名。

parts.name: Solid letterform
parts.desc: Heavy, leaning strokes turn the M into a bold silhouette.
parts.descZh: 粗重、倾斜的笔画让 M 成为一个醒目的剪影。

parts.name: Square container
parts.desc: High contrast black and white in a square made for small sizes.
parts.descZh: 黑白高对比、方形底，专为小尺寸准备。

logos.about: A large icon search site with free and paid icons. It now lives inside Magnific's (formerly Freepik's) icon section.
logos.aboutZh: 海量图标搜索网站，免费和付费图标都有。现在已经并入 Magnific（原 Freepik）的图标频道。
logos.audience: People who want to find a specific icon quickly.
logos.audienceZh: 想快速搜到某个图标的人。
logos.license: Free and premium items side by side; each icon page states its own license, and free items usually require attribution.
logos.licenseZh: 免费和付费并存，授权以每个图标页面的说明为准，免费素材通常要求署名。
logos.prompt: Design a lettermark for [brand]: the first letter drawn as two or three heavy solid blocks that still read as the letter, reversed out of a solid square in high contrast, readable at favicon size. Do not copy the Magnific/Iconfinder mark.
logos.promptZh: 为【品牌】设计一个字母标：把首字母画成两三块粗重的实心块，仍能读出是那个字母；放在纯色方块里反白，高对比，缩到网站图标大小也清楚。不要复制 Magnific / Iconfinder 的标志。

logos.name: iOS Icon Gallery
logos.read: A black rounded square inside a white rim: the mark is simply a picture of an app icon, the thing the site collects. Using the subject itself as the logo makes the purpose obvious at a glance.
logos.readZh: 白色外圈里一个黑色圆角方块——标志画的就是一个 App 图标，正是这个网站收集的东西。直接用题材本身当 logo，一眼就知道网站是做什么的。

parts.name: App icon silhouette
parts.desc: The continuous-corner rounded square of an iOS icon.
parts.descZh: iOS 图标那种平滑圆角的方块。

parts.name: White rim
parts.desc: A thick white border separates the shape from any background.
parts.descZh: 粗白边让图形在任何背景上都分得开。

parts.name: No detail
parts.desc: A flat black fill keeps attention on the silhouette.
parts.descZh: 纯黑填充，注意力只在轮廓上。

logos.about: A gallery of icons from the iOS App Store, with companion galleries for macOS and watchOS icons.
logos.aboutZh: 收集苹果 App Store 图标的展示站，另有 macOS 和 watchOS 图标分区。
logos.audience: People looking at well-made app icons for reference.
logos.audienceZh: 想参考精美 App 图标设计的人。
logos.license: The icons belong to their apps; view them for reference only.
logos.licenseZh: 图标归各 App 所有，只能参考，不能拿来用。
logos.prompt: Design a pictorial mark for [brand]: draw the single object the product is about as a flat silhouette with one fill colour, surrounded by a thick contrasting rim so it holds up on any background. Do not copy the iOS Icon Gallery logo.
logos.promptZh: 为【品牌】设计一个具象图形标：把产品围绕的那个物体画成纯色剪影，外面加一圈粗的对比色边，放在任何背景上都站得住。不要复制 iOS Icon Gallery 的 logo。

logos.name: Reeoo
logos.read: A blue disc carries one white line that runs right and hooks back, followed by three shorter lines like a trail of motion. The strokes share one weight and round caps, so the mark feels quick and light without depicting anything literal.
logos.readZh: 蓝色圆底上，一条白线向右延伸后回勾，下面跟着三条越来越短的线，像运动留下的轨迹。所有线条粗细一致、端点圆头，显得轻快，但并不画具体的东西。

parts.name: Hooked line
parts.desc: One continuous stroke gives the mark its main gesture.
parts.descZh: 一笔连续的线条构成主要动势。

parts.name: Speed lines
parts.desc: Shorter lines below suggest movement.
parts.descZh: 下方逐渐变短的线暗示运动。

parts.name: Blue disc
parts.desc: A gradient circle contains the strokes like an app icon.
parts.descZh: 渐变蓝色圆形把线条装起来，像一个 App 图标。

logos.about: A design reference site covering websites, apps, screenshots and tools; its icon section is a curated app icon gallery.
logos.aboutZh: 设计参考站，收录网站、App、截图和工具；其中的图标频道是一个精选 App 图标画廊。
logos.audience: People collecting good-looking icons and building a feel for icon design.
logos.audienceZh: 收集好看图标、做图标设计找感觉的人。
logos.license: The icons belong to their apps; view them for reference only.
logos.licenseZh: 图标归各 App 所有，只能参考，不能拿来用。
logos.prompt: Design an abstract mark for [brand]: one continuous rounded stroke that sets the main gesture, plus two or three shorter parallel strokes that suggest motion, all at the same weight with round caps, reversed out of a solid circle. Do not copy the Reeoo logo.
logos.promptZh: 为【品牌】设计一个抽象图形标：一条连续的圆头线条构成主要动势，再加两三条更短的平行线暗示运动，所有线条粗细一致、圆头，在纯色圆底上反白。不要复制 Reeoo 的 logo。

logos.name: Remix Icon
logos.read: A blue gradient shape is cut by one diagonal and a rounded notch, with a red dot set into the notch. It can be read as an abstract 'R', but it works first as a crisp geometric form; the small red dot is the accent that makes it memorable.
logos.readZh: 一块蓝色渐变图形被一条斜线和一个圆形缺口切开，缺口里嵌着一个红点。可以读成一个抽象的「R」，但它首先是一个干净的几何形；小红点是让人记住它的点睛色。

parts.name: Cut geometric body
parts.desc: A diagonal cut and a rounded notch shape the blue body.
parts.descZh: 一条斜切和一个圆形缺口塑造出蓝色主体。

parts.name: Accent dot
parts.desc: A small contrasting dot draws the eye.
parts.descZh: 一个对比色小圆点吸引视线。

parts.name: Gradient fill
parts.desc: Light-to-deep blue gives the flat shape some depth.
parts.descZh: 由浅到深的蓝色让平面图形有一点厚度。

logos.about: An open-source library of neutral-style system icons in outline and filled versions, available as SVG and an icon font.
logos.aboutZh: 开源的中性风格系统图标库，每个图标都有线性和面性两版，可用 SVG 或图标字体。
logos.audience: People who worry about copyright and want icons they can use with confidence.
logos.audienceZh: 怕版权风险、想放心使用的人。
logos.license: Remix Icon License v1.0 (since January 2026): free for personal and commercial projects, but the icons may not be used as a logo, trademark or app icon, and may not be resold as an icon pack. npm metadata still says Apache-2.0; the license file in the package is the one that applies.
logos.licenseZh: 自 2026 年 1 月起改用 Remix Icon License v1.0：个人和商业项目都能免费用，但不能用作 logo、商标或 App 图标，也不能当图标包单独卖。npm 上仍显示 Apache-2.0，以包内的 License 文件为准。
logos.prompt: Design an abstract mark for [brand]: one solid geometric shape shaped by a single diagonal cut and one rounded notch, with a small dot in a contrasting accent colour placed in the notch, light-to-deep gradient on the main shape. Do not copy the Remix Icon logo.
logos.promptZh: 为【品牌】设计一个抽象图形标：一块实心几何图形，用一条斜切和一个圆形缺口塑形，在缺口里放一个对比色小圆点，主体用由浅到深的渐变。不要复制 Remix Icon 的 logo。

logos.name: iconfont
logos.read: A cyan droplet with two big eyes and slanted lids becomes a character with attitude. A face is the fastest way to make a mark feel alive; the droplet outline keeps it simple enough to recognise at small sizes.
logos.readZh: 一滴青色水滴加上两只大眼睛和斜斜的眼皮，变成一个有态度的角色。加一张脸是让标志「活起来」最快的办法；水滴外形又足够简单，小尺寸也认得出。

parts.name: Droplet body
parts.desc: A simple teardrop silhouette in bright cyan.
parts.descZh: 亮青色的简单水滴轮廓。

parts.name: Expressive eyes
parts.desc: Large eyes with slanted lids give the character a mood.
parts.descZh: 大眼睛加斜眼皮，给角色一种情绪。

parts.name: Dark outline
parts.desc: A dark teal outline holds the shapes together.
parts.descZh: 深青色描边把各部分收在一起。

logos.about: Alibaba's vector icon library: search and download icons, keep them in online projects, and export them as SVG or an icon font.
logos.aboutZh: 阿里出品的矢量图标库，图标数量多、风格全，可以搜索下载、建项目在线管理，并导出 SVG 或图标字体。
logos.audience: Designers and developers who want to find an icon and use it directly.
logos.audienceZh: 想找图标直接用的设计师和程序员。
logos.license: Icons are uploaded by users; copyright and licensing vary by icon and collection, so check each one before commercial use.
logos.licenseZh: 图标由用户上传，版权和授权因图标、图标库而异，商用前逐个确认。
logos.prompt: Design a mascot mark for [brand]: one simple, bold silhouette taken from the brand's subject, given a face with two large expressive eyes, a single bright colour with a darker outline, recognisable at 32px. Do not copy the iconfont mascot.
logos.promptZh: 为【品牌】设计一个吉祥物标：从品牌主题里取一个简单醒目的轮廓，加上一张脸和两只有表情的大眼睛，单一亮色加深色描边，32px 下仍能认出。不要复制 iconfont 的吉祥物。

logos.name: Logobook
logos.note: The source video shows a crowned 'b' for Logobook. That image is the thumbnail of the site's 'Crowns' category, someone else's trademark from the archive, so the site's own logomark is used here.
logos.noteZh: 原视频里给 Logobook 配的是一个带皇冠的「b」，那其实是该站「Crowns」分类的缩略图，属于档案里别人的商标；这里用的是 Logobook 自己的标志。
logos.read: An open black book holds a globe on the left page and an 'L' in a circle on the right. The book outline contains everything, so the mark reads as one badge that says exactly what the site is: a book of the world's logos.
logos.readZh: 一本打开的黑色书，左页是地球，右页是圆圈里的「L」。书本外形把所有元素装在一起，整体读成一枚徽章，正好说明网站是什么：一本收录全世界 logo 的书。

parts.name: Book container
parts.desc: The open-book silhouette encloses the other symbols.
parts.descZh: 打开的书本轮廓把其它符号装在里面。

parts.name: Globe
parts.desc: Stands for 'the world's' logos.
parts.descZh: 代表「全世界的」logo。

parts.name: Circled L
parts.desc: The initial of Logobook in a reversed circle.
parts.descZh: Logobook 的首字母，放在反白的圆里。

logos.about: An archive of logos, symbols and trademarks from around the world, browsable by letter, shape and object.
logos.aboutZh: 收录世界各国经典标志和商标的网站，可以按字母、形状、物体分类浏览。
logos.audience: People who want master-level logo examples to study mark design.
logos.audienceZh: 想看大师级 logo 案例、学习标志设计的人。
logos.license: The logos are trademarks of their owners; study them, don't reuse them.
logos.licenseZh: 收录的都是各自所有者的商标，只能学习，不能挪用。
logos.prompt: Design an emblem for [brand]: one container shape that names what the product is (for example a book, a box or a shield), with two simple symbols placed inside it, one of them the brand initial in a reversed circle; strict black and white. Do not copy the Logobook logo.
logos.promptZh: 为【品牌】设计一个徽章标：用一个能说明产品是什么的外框（比如书、盒子、盾牌），里面放两个简单符号，其中一个是放在反白圆里的品牌首字母；只用黑白两色。不要复制 Logobook 的 logo。

logos.name: Icônes
logos.read: A single high-contrast serif 'Ô' with its circumflex. The accent is the memorable detail: it comes straight from the name Icônes and turns a plain letter into something ownable.
logos.readZh: 一个高对比衬线体「Ô」加上帽子符号。这个音调符号就是记忆点：它直接来自名字 Icônes，让一个普通字母变成独有的标志。

parts.name: Single letter
parts.desc: One 'O' carries the whole name.
parts.descZh: 一个「O」代表整个名字。

parts.name: Circumflex accent
parts.desc: The accent from the name becomes the distinctive detail.
parts.descZh: 名字里的音调符号成为辨识点。

parts.name: Contrast serif
parts.desc: Thick and thin strokes give a classic, typographic feel.
parts.descZh: 粗细对比明显的笔画，带来经典的排版气质。

logos.about: An open-source icon explorer built on Iconify that searches hundreds of open-source icon sets in one place and copies icons as SVG or component code.
logos.aboutZh: 开源的图标浏览器，基于 Iconify 把上百个开源图标集聚合在一起，一站搜遍，可以直接复制 SVG 或组件代码。
logos.audience: People who don't want to dig through icon sites one by one.
logos.audienceZh: 懒得挨个网站翻图标的人。
logos.license: The site is MIT-licensed; every icon set keeps its own license, shown on the set's page.
logos.licenseZh: 网站本身 MIT 开源；每个图标集各有自己的授权，在图标集页面上标明。
logos.prompt: Design a lettermark for [brand]: one letter from the name in a high-contrast serif, made distinctive by a single detail taken from the name itself (an accent, a ligature or a punctuation mark), black on white. Do not copy the Icônes logo.
logos.promptZh: 为【品牌】设计一个字母标：取名字里的一个字母，用高对比衬线体，再从名字本身取一个细节让它与众不同（音调符号、连字或标点），白底黑字。不要复制 Icônes 的 logo。
